name: Modern Tech Resume Pack — 5 ATS-Optimized Templates
tagline: 5 designer-quality 1-page resumes proven to pass ATS and impress recruiters
includes: 5 distinct resume templates (LaTeX + DOCX + Google Docs)
target_buyer: Software engineers, product managers, designers, data scientists applying to tech jobs
v1_remaining_work: Run deliverables/compile.sh to produce 5 PDFs from the .tex files (or follow deliverables/COMPILE.md for Overleaf) — 5-10 min for bash loop, 30 min for Overleaf manual
Validate each PDF renders at exactly 1 page on a stock letter-size paper — 5 min
Convert each PDF to DOCX (use a tool like pandoc, or just rebuild in Google Docs) — 1-2 hours, or ship LaTeX-only and document the conversion
Add a cover letter template that matches each style (currently only the resume templates are built) — 1-2 hours
Add a LinkedIn bio template per style — 30 min
Write the ATS optimization guide (currently referenced in includes[] but not a separate file) — 30 min
Write the format & export guide (PDF, DOCX, Google Docs handoff) — 20 min
Add 2-page version of each style — 2-3 hours (mostly copy-paste, rebalance content)
Generate 1 cover PNG (1600x2000) for the Etsy/Gumroad listing — 30 min
Generate 5 mockup PNGs (1 per style) — 1 hour in Canva from the rendered PDFs

blockers: LaTeX is hard for non-technical buyers — ship as a PDF/Google Docs bundle, not raw .tex
build_to_revenue_path.shipping_tip: Compile the 5 PDFs and ship the PDF bundle today on Etsy. Mention 'LaTeX source included' as a power-user bonus. Add DOCX/Google Docs versions in v1.1.
